warning[ZBX-W0302]: the container's cgroup scope was left behind
  while  making sure the container's scope zbx-web-1.scope is gone
  cause  systemd answered org.freedesktop.DBus.Error.AccessDenied: Refused
  scope  zbx-web-1.scope
  fix    remove it by hand:   systemctl --user stop zbx-web-1.scope
  more   zbx explain W0302
  docs   https://zigbox.github.io/zigbox/errors/W0302.html
